parsed.explanation: The dossier documents an actively enforced criminal statute (documented arrests, convictions, torture allegations, mass arrests including 71 men facing up to 20 years under the escalated 2026 law) that explicitly extends to 'transsexuality' via its new promotion/support ban. The same-sex-conduct law functions as a police lever against gender-nonconforming people (goor-jigen described as often facing prosecution), not a dead letter. Tier-2 features: state enforcement surges at political moments, border-post arrests of those fleeing, and documented mob violence including body desecration with apparent impunity and no recourse, since authorities reject anti-discrimination recommendations and violence reporting is suppressed. No legal gender recognition, and enforcement risk is explicitly maintained. This sits between severe (near-systematic raids, no organised sweeps of every visitor) and high risk: severity is major-to-severe with rising penalties and documented lethal hostility, pushing from 0.25 toward 0.20.
